name: pg_sqljson_queryfuncs_jsonexpr_deparsing_quote
subject: Fix JsonExpr deparsing to quote variable names in the PASSING clause.
goal:
Deparsing a SQL/JSON expression can omit required quoting around variable names in its PASSING clause. A stored expression using a case-sensitive name or a name colliding with a type keyword then changes meaning when printed and reparsed.

Create a constraint or view containing JSON_EXISTS with variables such as `AS "int"`, `AS "TXT"` and an ordinary `AS arr`, then inspect and replay its definition. Required quotes and case must be preserved, while names that are safe unquoted may remain unquoted. JSON_QUERY must continue to distinguish `$Xyz` from `$"Xyz"` according to the declared PASSING name.
